jobs.title: Lead, Office of Software Assurance
jobs.desc: Role Summary Â The Office of Software Assurance (OSA) Lead is the senior individual contributor who establishes and leads the Office of Software Assurance, a new shift-left software quality function inside the Agile Office, through technical expertise and influence rather than line management. The OSA embeds right-sized, risk-based assurance into a 1,000+ person Engineering organization, so that compliance evidence is produced as a natural, tool-native output of how teams build, not assembled after the fact. Â You will own day-to-day software quality execution across three lifecycle domains (SDLC, Computer Software Assurance, and Infrastructure Qualification). Nateraâs Software Quality Assurance department keeps independent oversight, approval authority, and the front-line role in audits and inspections. Your focus is faster, simpler, and compliant delivery, and you do it in a way you can defend to an auditor. The ideal candidate is a software engineer first, someone who understands code, CI/CD, and engineering tooling, and who has worked close enough to regulated environments to apply quality and regulatory expectations without becoming a bottleneck. Â What You Will Do Â Stand up the OSA and execute its charter in phases: Launch (engineering-tool assurance), Extend (product-software assurance planning and evidence-readiness review), and Mature (largely automated, tool-native release-readiness evidence, with SQA operating by exception). Own the OSA Charter and the OSA Responsibility Governance Matrix, and keep them current with SQA concurrence. Review annually or sooner as responsibilities phase in. Provide technical direction, coaching, and quality review for the OSA assurance resources, and contribute to their hiring and development plans in partnership with the Head of Agile Office. Coordinate, coach, and quality-check the engineers assigned the SQE capability within engineering teams. Define baselines and targets with the Sponsor and report on OSA success metrics: assurance turnaround and cycle time versus the legacy CSV path, deliverables per release versus the 8â10-per-release baseline, intake quality, SQA relief, inspection readiness, and capability milestones. Deliver right-sized assurance Oversee AL1âAL2 assurance planning and participate in AL3âAL4 assurance under the CSA SOP. This covers the path from CSA Intake through Software Assurance Plan, execution, report and closeout, and Service Catalog registration. Recommend the Assurance Level and assurance approach at CSA Intake. Select assurance activities and acceptance criteria from the Assurance Method Menu within an assigned level. Support SQA's level-confirmation walkthroughs. Drive a documented-critical-thinking culture. Teams should be able to explain their risk-based rationale to an auditor and apply the least-burdensome approach. Provide oversight, guidance, and continued standardization under the SDLC SOP and Infrastructure Qualification. Over time, provide product-software risk-classification input, assurance and verification planning, evidence-readiness review, and periodic review by Assurance Level. Â Govern engineering tools and change Own and execute the Engineering Tool Governance Work Instruction, from tool admission through retirement. Own and manage the Engineering Service Catalog, including registration of tools that hold regulated records. Oversee tool qualification. Provide fast-path change oversight and impact disposition on engineering tickets under the Software Change Work Instruction. Route device-software changes to SQA. Consult with Agile Office tooling administration on the assurance impact of tooling decisions. Â Partner with Software Quality Assurance (SQA) and the business Operate the inspection-readiness model: the OSA executes and supplies the technical narrative and tool-native evidence, while SQA approves determinations, plans, and closeouts and leads in audits and inspections. Maintain defined escalation triggers to SQA. Escalate unresolved scope or risk questions to the Sponsor and SQA leadership. Work with Product Managers and Lab Directors, who hold charter-level accountability for intended use and business need, so intended use is clearly communicated at intake and confirmed at delivery. Collaborate with the Security Team on lifecycle integration points (cybersecurity methodology stays with Security) and with Regulatory/QA on design-control boundaries. Â Build capability and automate Lead delivery of the SQE Upskilling Competency Development Plan across four tiers: regulatory and standards literacy, risk-based assurance and critical thinking, modern V V and tool-native evidence practices, and quality judgment. Provide compliant-SDLC coaching, process-feedback management, and training content. Source external training through bodies such as AAMI, ISPE, RAPS, and ASQ. Champion automation: embed evidence capture in the tools of record (for example, source control, ticketing, CI/CD, and test management), so evidence is cited by reference rather than assembled by hand. Â Required Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience). 8+ years of software engineering experience, with hands-on development, test automation, DevOps, or engineering productivity work. You can read code and review pipelines, and you earn credibility with engineers. 4+ years working in or closely alongside a regulated environment, such as medical device, diagnostics, clinical laboratory, pharma or biotech, or another environment under design controls and a quality management system. Working knowledge of risk-based software assurance and validation concepts, such as FDA Computer Software Assurance (CSA) guidance, computer system validation, or software verification and validation. Practical familiarity with several of: IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, 21 CFR Part 820 / QMSR, 21 CFR Part 11, IEC 81001-5-1, AAMI TIR45. 3+ years of technical leadership experience, such as leading cross-functional programs through influence and mentoring engineers, and experience building or scaling a process or function. People management experience is a plus but not required. Demonstrated ability to partner with an independent quality function and to hold a clear line between execution and independent oversight. Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain a risk rationale to engineers, executives, and auditors. Â Preferred Direct experience supporting or hosting FDA, notified-body, CAP, CLIA, or ISO audits and inspections. Experience with AI, agile at scale, engineering tool governance, or tool qualification. Experience with GAMP 5, SaaS or cloud-tool qualification, or infrastructure qualification for software and cloud platforms. Experience automating compliance evidence in tools such as Jira and Jama, source control, CI/CD, and test management platforms. Experience in clinical diagnostics, genomics, or lab informatics software. Certifications such as ASQ CSQE, CQA, or RAPS RAC. Experience designing competency or upskilling programs for engineers. The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives. The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, youâll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, youâll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management. jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.desc: Founded in 2010 in the Netherlands, AnywhereNow is a global leader in Enterprise Dialogue Management, with a vision to ensure every employee and customer feels heard, understood, and valued. Today, our team of approximately 240 employees spans 22 countries, supporting more than 2,000 organisations worldwide. We partner with leading enterprises including Mazda , the UN International Organization for Migration , The Adecco Group , and the University of Cape Town to deliver exceptional customer and employee experiences through the power of Microsoft Teams and AI-driven innovation. Driven by our commitment to innovation, customer focus, accountability, and continuous improvement, we help organisations modernise communication and customer engagement across complex enterprise environments. Our portfolio includes: Dialogue Cloud – our enterprise dialogue management platform built for Microsoft Teams. Deepdesk – AI-powered Agent Assist technology that helps service teams work faster and smarter. Tendfor – a customer engagement and contact centre solution designed for Microsoft Teams environments. Together, these solutions enable organisations to create more intelligent, efficient, and personalised experiences for both customers and employees. As we continue to accelerate our AI-first strategy, we're investing heavily in the next generation of agentic solutions, creating exciting opportunities for engineers who want to help shape the future of enterprise AI. About the Role We're looking for an AI Engineer to help build the next generation of AI-powered enterprise solutions. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on designing, building, and scaling intelligent agents across the Microsoft ecosystem. You'll transform defined business use cases into production-ready agentic solutions, leveraging modern AI technologies, Azure services, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) architecture. As part of the Agent Factory team, you'll develop agents that can securely access enterprise systems, interact with business tools, manage context and memory effectively, and operate reliably at scale. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and AI leadership to ensure every solution delivers real business value while meeting enterprise standards for security, performance, and governance. Beyond technical delivery, you'll bring product thinking and commercial awareness, helping to identify meaningful customer challenges, emerging AI opportunities, and relevant market trends. Your insights will contribute to shaping and refining the Agent Factory roadmap and backlog. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building practical AI applications and can take solutions from concept through to production deployment. What You'll Be Doing Build and Deliver Intelligent Agents Design, build and deploy AI agents that solve real customer and business problems. Create agents that deliver value independently while contributing insights to a broader intelligence ecosystem. Translate product requirements and use cases into scalable, production-ready solutions. Develop MCP-Based Integrations Build and operate Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that provide agents with secure access to tools, systems and enterprise data. Define and implement tool interfaces, authentication mechanisms and resource access patterns. Ensure agents can interact with enterprise services in a structured, secure and reliable way. Integrate Enterprise Systems Connect agents with business-critical platforms including: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Microsoft Graph Dataverse ServiceNow Contact Centre and Customer Experience platforms Internal and third-party APIs Design Context, Memory Intelligence Define how agents manage memory, context and decision-making patterns. Implement retrieval, reasoning and tool-use strategies that promote consistent and predictable behaviour. Design guardrails that enable agents to operate safely and effectively within enterprise environments. Contribute to the Agent Ecosystem Develop supporting services including adapters, event processing capabilities and integration layers. Enable agents to share insights and consume intelligence from a wider ecosystem of interconnected solutions. Help shape future product direction by contributing technical expertise, customer insights and market observations. What You'll Bring Microsoft Technology Expertise Strong software engineering experience using C# and .NET . Hands-on experience with Azure services, including: Azure Functions Azure App Service Azure OpenAI Service Azure AI Foundry / AI Studio Experience integrating with Microsoft business platforms such as: Dynamics 365 Dataverse Microsoft Graph Power Platform Knowledge of Azure security and identity services, including: Microsoft Entra ID Managed Identities Azure Key Vault Agentic AI MCP Experience Practical experience building or consuming MCP servers. Knowledge of agent frameworks and orchestration technologies such as: Semantic Kernel AutoGen Microsoft AI SDKs Experience with: Function and tool calling Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Vector databases Context and memory management Ability to design clear, reliable and secure agent interactions.# Broader Engineering Skills Strong API integration experience, including REST APIs, webhooks and event-driven architectures. Experience with cloud-native deployment, CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code approaches. Understanding of performance, latency, reliability and cost considerations when working with Large Language Models in production. Commitment to software quality, testing and continuous improvement. Ability to work closely with QA teams on agent evaluation, testing and quality assurance. Who You Are You'll be successful in this role if you are: A pragmatic builder who can take ideas from concept to production. Passionate about applying AI to solve real-world business challenges. Comfortable working independently while collaborating with cross-functional teams. A systems thinker who understands how individual components contribute to larger platforms and architectures. Security-conscious and focused on building reliable enterprise-grade solutions. Excited by emerging AI technologies and eager to learn as the landscape evolves. Nice to Have While not essential, we'd be particularly interested in candidates with experience in: Multi-agent architectures and agent-to-agent communication. Delivering AI solutions within enterprise or regulated environments. LLM observability, monitoring, tracing, and evaluation frameworks. Contact Centre, Customer Experience, or enterprise workflow automation platforms. Why Join Us? This is an opportunity to help shape the future of AI within a rapidly evolving product organisation. You'll work with cutting-edge Microsoft AI technologies, contribute directly to innovative agentic solutions, and play a key role in building scalable AI capabilities that deliver measurable value to customers. If you're passionate about building intelligent systems and want to be at the forefront of enterprise AI innovation, we'd love to hear from you. Information Security Responsibilities At AnywhereNow, information security is everyone's responsibility. All employees are expected to actively support and maintain the organisation's information security standards and contribute to protecting the confidentiality, integrity and availability of company and customer information. This includes: Adhering to all applicable information security policies, procedures and guidelines at all times. Protecting company, customer and partner data from unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration or loss. Using company systems, devices and networks in a secure and compliant manner. Promptly reporting any suspected or actual security incidents, breaches or vulnerabilities to the appropriate team. Completing mandatory information security and data protection training as required. Ensuring that confidential information is handled and stored securely in accordance with company policies and applicable legal requirements. Failure to comply with information security responsibilities may result in disciplinary action. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow
